dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure that... the photo is fine?

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: It's totally fine! A commemoration picture could always benefit from a dose of quirkiness!

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: Ah! Summer! Wonderful summer! The good times never last... I wish times like this would be like a show that never ends...
